question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Laconic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Concise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Laconic"** means using very few words; concise or terse. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **His laconic reply suggested he was not interested in the conversation.
 
 
 
• **"Concise"** refers to giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The report was concise, covering all the main points in just two pages.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Concise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reasonable** (तर्कसंगत): Based on or using good judgment and therefore fair and practical.

 
 
• **Example:** It is reasonable to expect that students will do their homework.
 
 
 
• **Fanciful** (कल्पनाशील): Over-imaginative and unrealistic.
 
 
• **Example:** The story was filled with fanciful characters like talking animals and magical beings.
 
 
 
• **Certain** (निश्चित): Known for sure; established beyond doubt.
 
 
• **Example:** It is certain that the sun will rise in the east.
